instruction: How much has this applied to you over the past week?

questions.q2: I felt my heart beating fast even though I had not made any physical effort
questions.q3: I was afraid for no reason
questions.q4: I felt I had nothing to look forward to
questions.q6: I was unable to become enthusiastic about anything
questions.q7: I found it hard to wind down
questions.q9: I found it difficult to relax

categories.anxiety_desc: Measures situational anxiety, physical tension, and feelings of nervousness.
categories.depression_desc: Measures low energy, lack of positive feelings, and difficulty feeling enthusiastic.
categories.stress_desc: Measures difficulty relaxing, restlessness, and emotional tension.

messages.anxiety_mild: Your responses suggest mild or situational anxiety. Everyday stress can sometimes feel elevated, but gentle mindfulness and breathing can keep you grounded.
messages.anxiety_moderate: Your responses suggest moderate anxiety. You may be experiencing occasional physical or mental tension that impacts your calm.
messages.anxiety_severe: Your responses indicate elevated anxiety that may be interfering with your daily peace of mind.
messages.anxiety_extremely_severe: Your responses indicate a high level of anxiety and distress right now. Connecting with a professional can provide safety and relief.
messages.depression_mild: Your responses suggest minimal to mild low mood. Gentle self-care and staying connected with supportive routines is helpful.
messages.depression_moderate: Your responses suggest moderate low mood or low enthusiasm. Speaking with a therapist can provide valuable guidance.
messages.depression_severe: Your responses suggest you are carrying a noticeable emotional weight right now.
messages.depression_extremely_severe: Your responses suggest a high level of emotional heaviness. Professional guidance can help you navigate this safely.
messages.stress_mild: Your responses indicate a manageable level of everyday stress.
messages.stress_moderate: Your responses suggest moderate stress and difficulty unwinding. Small intentional breaks can help restore balance.
messages.stress_severe: Your responses suggest high stress levels that may affect your sleep and energy.
messages.stress_extremely_severe: Your responses suggest an intense level of stress right now. Letting a professional help you unpack this can bring relief.

report.title: Your Emotional Snapshot
report.desc: Here is an overview of how you have been feeling across key emotional indicators.
report.talk_sub: Professional support is available whenever you need it.
